rules.label: Second explicitly disclosed research batch after six equity candidates failed

strategies.dual_momentum: Every 20 NSE sessions use previous close's 126-session return. Invest in the higher positive-return ETF, otherwise cash. Sell at close of holding session 20. Next cycle starts following open.
strategies.diversified_trend: Every 20 sessions allocate 50% to each ETF only when prior close exceeds its SMA200. Inactive half stays cash. Sell at holding session 20 close.

rules.costs: 0.15% fee/tax scenario and 0.05% slippage each side; stress double. Fully funded, no leverage. No 0.5%-risk stop: ETF portfolio exposure can reach 100%, so risk differs from the stock experiments.
rules.gate: Historical candidate only: positive in all three retrospective periods and positive recent doubled-cost result. Not a live/prospective validation. Asset choice is made after observing the broad market environment.
rules.daily_profit: Report losing days and worst daily loss. Never equate period profits with daily income.
